decision: Preserve all original grades; exclude the whole task uniformly from primary candidate selection and report all-task sensitivity.
reason: Task explicitly rejects booleans, negatives and non-integer strings but does not define whether numeric floats are accepted. The external oracle also rejects 2.5. GLM/combined truncates that value with int(); this is an under-specified test requirement, not an established prompt regression.
future_development_selection: Use the other eleven unchanged development tasks. Do not rewrite this task after observing candidate results.
